How Much Is a Pint in Manchester? (2026 Prices)

A pint in Manchester typically costs about £6.50 in 2026, a little under London and well above the UK average of £4.74. Happy hour brings it down to around £4. Here's what we found across more than 40 Manchester pubs and bars.

By the ontap team · 3 November 2026

Manchester pint prices at a glance

PriceSource
UK average, pint of lager£4.74ONS, Aug 2026
UK average, all pints (pubs)£5.34Morning Advertiser, Apr 2026
Middle of the Manchester menus we checked£6.50ontap, 2026 (half paid £5.95–£6.85)
Typical Manchester happy-hour pint£4.00ontap, 2026
Hotel bars (Malmaison, Dakota)£7.50ontap, 2026

City-centre bars and chains publish their menus, so they make up most of what we found; a back-street local will often be cheaper than the middle figure.

What drives the price

  • The beer: Holt's and Samuel Smith's cask bitter is the cheapest pint in town; premium lager and craft IPA sit at £6.50–£7.50.
  • The postcode: Deansgate, Spinningfields and hotel bars cost the most; the Northern Quarter has the most happy hours.
  • The time: plenty of bars knock £2–3 off a pint between 3pm and 7pm.

How we got these numbers

We collected 81 Manchester pint prices from 42 pubs and bars in 2026, using their own menus, chain menus and recent articles, and recorded where each came from and when. The middle figure uses menu prices only; happy hours are counted separately.

FAQ

How much is a pint in Manchester?

About £6.50 in 2026 going by bar and pub menus; half the prices we found were between £5.95 and £6.85.

Where's the cheapest pint in Manchester?

Students' union bars (from £3), Holt's pubs and Samuel Smith's pubs (around £3.50). See the tables above.

Is Manchester cheaper than London for a pint?

A little. The middle of the Manchester menus we checked was £6.50, against about £7 in London.
